basic_details.job_title: ESIC Assam Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview of ESIC Hospital, Tinsukia is on 8 December 2026 at 11:00 AM. Document verification runs from 10:00 am to 11:00 am at ESIC Hospital, Tinsukia, Sector-2, Bordoloi Nagar, Tinsukia, Assam-786125 (the venue is tentative). The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt. of India) is filling 4 Senior Resident (SR) posts against vacant GDMO posts, 3 in Accident & Emergency and 1 in Medicine, on contract for one year at a consolidated Rs.1,14,955/- per month. Applications are to reach the hospital by 3 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and all others is as per Central Government Rule. No age relaxation is available to an SC/ST/OBC candidate applying for unreserved vacancies.

how_to_apply: Applicants are requested to fill in the Common Application Form for Walk-in Interview for recruitment of SR against GDMO on purely contractual basis (printed on page 4 of the notice). The form is filled in BLOCK letters. It asks for the post applied for, name, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age on the date of interview, citizenship, addresses, mobile number, e-mail ID, gender, caste, religion, height in inches, Aadhar number, marital status, educational qualification with year of passing, registration number and details, experience, and a list of enclosures. It ends with a signed declaration that a wrong detail found at any stage cancels the candidature.

The form is sent with the MCI/SMC number and a contact number by email to [email protected], or offline at ESIC Hospital Tinsukia. The last date of submission is 3 December 2026. The notice's letterhead gives the hospital's email as [email protected].
important_instructions: Selected candidates must furnish a DD/Bankers Cheque of Rs. 30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) drawn in favour of "ESI Fund Account No. 1", payable at Tinsukia, as security deposit. If a selected candidate resigns or terminates the contract within 09 months of its commencement, with or without prior notice, the Rs. 30,000/- security money will be forfeited. The recruitment is purely on contractual basis. Selected candidates have no claim for regularization of service in the hospital. Private practice of any kind is not allowed. ESI Corporation may increase, decrease or cancel the filling of any or all posts without assigning reasons, at the discretion of the Appointing Authority. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: About the Hospital
content_sections.text: ESIC Hospital Tinsukia is a hospital of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation under the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt. of India. It is at Sector-2, Bordoloi Nagar, Tinsukia, Assam-786125. The posts are for this hospital and are on a purely contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: For the Casualty department, a PG degree or diploma in any subject is accepted. Preference will be given to PG pass-out candidates. If PG candidates are not available, MBBS with at least 02 years' working experience in the same discipline is required. Of this, 1 year must be in the concerned field at a Govt. hospital or private hospital (not a private clinic) as Senior Resident on contractual basis. Not exceeding 45 years as on the date of interview. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC and all others is as per Central Government Rule. No age relaxation is available to an SC/ST/OBC candidate applying for unreserved vacancies. The consolidated remuneration is Rs.1,14,955/- per month. The tenure is 01 (one) year or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of this amount. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must appear with all testimonials in original and one self-attested copy of each. The notice lists these documents: Age proof (Class 10th certificate / Birth certificate) MBBS certificate BDS certificate for Dental department Two recent passport size photographs PG Degree / Diploma certificate MCI/SMC Registration Certificate with MD/MS/DNB qualification Experience certificate, if applicable No Objection Certificate from the employer, for a candidate who is in service (to be submitted at the time of interview)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants are requested to fill in the Common Application Form for Walk-in Interview for recruitment of SR against GDMO on purely contractual basis (printed on page 4 of the notice). It ends with a signed declaration that a wrong detail found at any stage cancels the candidature. content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Document verification is held from 10:00 am to 11:00 am on 8 December 2026. Only candidates whose documents are verified are allowed to attend the walk-in interview, which begins at 11:00 AM. The decision of the Selection Board is final on all aspects of selection, and no further correspondence is entertained. Selection is subject to the candidate proving medical fitness. In case of selection, an offer of appointment will be issued as per requirement.

faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 3 in Accident & Emergency (SC 1, OBC 1, EWS 1, UR 0) and 1 in Medicine (OBC 1).

If PG candidates are not available, MBBS with at least 02 years' experience in the same discipline is required.

faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.1,14,955/- per month.
